about.description: Single-stock perpetual market tracking Microsoft Corporation. Users get linear exposure to Microsoft share-price moves without owning shares, voting rights, or dividend claims, with pricing referencing an external 24/5 equity feed. Positions are margined and cash-settled in USDT. Markets are visible on Hyperliquid under the cash namespace, but are operated by Dreamcash rather than listed as core Hyperliquid perps.
